items.title: Non-league Brit goalie set to become king of Ugandan kingdom after royal selection
items.summary: A NON-LEAGUE goalie could be set to be the safe hands of a royal crown — after being chosen as the next king of a Ugandan kingdom.  George Desmond Kamurasi — who plays in the ninth tier of English football — has been selected by a committee to be the ruler of the Tooro people. ...
